sources.title: Turkish and German AI models - a mertkayacs Collection
sources.snippet: Karar-4B and Wähler-4B: small Turkish and German LLMs for text classification and decisions with probabilities. Full weights and GGUF builds.

sources.title: mertkayacs/Wahler-4B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Quantized GGUF files for Wähler-4B, the German decision model. The Q4_K_M file is the default; Q5_K_M and Q8_0 are higher fidelity at the cost of speed and memory.

sources.snippet: Wahler-4B by mertkayacs is a decision model. Wahler-4B by mertkayacs is a decision model: it answers typed questions with a probability for each allowed answer instead of generating text.
